description: Report the active release, the full release history, the gateway host, the live URL and whether the active release has outbound internet access (egress) — "none" or "internet" — for one project. For a project with a RightSide database, `database` gives its size against its limit; `state` is "warning" from 80% and "over_limit" above it, with a suggestedFix.
name: project_status
